new_findings.title: Participation cap is provably inert at the frozen reference AUM; scored weights are exactly 1/N_book
new_findings.detail: For any bookable book, cap term = 0.15 * DVmed60 / 1,000,000 >= 0.30 (eligibility floor DVmed60 >= $2M), while 1/N_book <= 0.10 (bookability floor N_book >= 10). Therefore min(1/N_book, cap term) = 1/N_book for every legal name at every date: the cap can never bind in the scored run. The capacity number is still well-defined (AUM where the binding member first binds = N_book * 0.15 * min DVmed60, >= ~$3M at the floor) and is reported 'not tuned'. Remediation is a disclosure sentence: §9 should state that the cap does not bind at AUM_ref=$1M in the scored run, so the capacity report is not read as an active constraint and the frozen cap law is not mistaken for a scored-number input.

new_findings.title: Bookability parenthetical '(equivalently N_eligible >= 50)' is arithmetically wrong; correct equivalence is N_eligible >= 46
new_findings.detail: Sec3: 'bookable iff N_book >= 10 (equivalently N_eligible >= 50)'. With N_book = ceil(0.20 * N_eligible): N_eligible = 45 gives N_book = 9 (not bookable); N_eligible in {46..49} gives N_book = 10 (bookable). So the exact equivalence is N_eligible >= 46, not >= 50. A decision date with N_eligible in {46..49} is bookable under the operative clause but flat under the gloss — a scored-number difference if an implementer codes the parenthetical. The operative clause ('bookable iff N_book >= 10') and the §8 golden fixture ('N_book < 10 => flat, counted') are unambiguous and agree, so this does not rise to HIGH; but family_contract.json commits §3 verbatim at D1, so the parenthetical must be corrected (to 'N_eligible >= 46' or deleted) BEFORE the D1 freeze. Binding into D1.

new_findings.title: F3b three-class taxonomy is not literally exhaustive over conceivable division sites (second-moment denominators)
new_findings.detail: Classes are (i) price, (ii) dollar-volume, (iii) count/PnL-sum. A variance/second-moment denominator (e.g. beta = cov/var(SPY) in the vol/beta attribution, or any realized-vol ratio) fits none of the three literally. The operative catch-alls still close the structural hole — 'EVERY division ... no exceptions', 'a division site found outside the register = HIGH', and the §8 register-completeness fixture ('a fixture-built unregistered site must be caught') — so an unregistered site cannot pass silently; but D1's division_site_register.json must assign every site a class, so the plan (or D1) should state how a second-moment denominator is housed (recommended: fail-loud under the class-iii convention). Non-blocking; binding at D1 register construction.
